status.critical: 🚨 CRITICAL FINANCIAL NOTICE: Immediate spending reduction required to avoid negative balances and high risk escalation.
status.warning: ⚠️ FINANCIAL WARNING: Reserve threshold, gap, or moderate risk detected. Prioritize emergency reserves before major purchases.
status.safe: 🟢 FINANCIAL HEALTH SAFE: Excellent cash flow stability, positive forward runway, and low risk score.

below.detail: Your projected balance ({{balance}}) drops below your recommended 3-month emergency reserve threshold ({{threshold}}). Building a liquid emergency reserve protects against unforeseen financial shocks.

action.inr: Prioritize building this reserve using low-risk liquid options such as a Bank Recurring Deposit (RD) or high-liquidity savings before allocating to long-term commitments. Check current terms on the official site.
action.default: Prioritize building this reserve using low-risk liquid options such as a high-yield savings account or short-term certificate of deposit before committing to illiquid assets.

ok.detail: Your starting balance ({{balance}}) comfortably exceeds your 3-month emergency reserve threshold ({{threshold}}).
ok.action: Maintain current reserve levels and direct surplus monthly cash flow into long-term savings or investments.

high.detail: Total financial risk score is High ({{score}}/100). High expense growth or heavy fixed obligations threaten cash flow stability.
high.action: Audit recurring obligations and pause high-cost discretionary spending to reduce risk escalation.

medium.detail: Financial risk score is Medium ({{score}}/100). Current spending patterns warrant proactive management.
medium.action: Aim to maintain a savings ratio above 30% to build a resilient buffer.

low.detail: Financial risk score is Low ({{score}}/100). Savings ratio and fixed commitments remain within optimal benchmarks.
low.action: Continue disciplined monthly budgeting to maintain stable low-risk financial standing.

gap.title: Health Insurance Coverage Gap
gap.detail: No insurance premium found in your recorded transactions for active emergency/medical goal '{{goalName}}'. Relying solely on cash savings for medical events risks depleting your liquid reserves rapidly.

action.inr: Explore comprehensive health cover (e.g. Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY or individual health policies) to protect emergency reserves. Check current terms on the official site.
action.default: Explore dedicated health insurance options to safeguard your emergency cash reserves against major unexpected medical events.

planning.title: Future Expense Planning: {{goalName}}
planning.detail: Upcoming target '{{goalName}}' requires {{monthlyNeeded}}/mo across {{months}} remaining months. Your current monthly surplus ({{surplus}}/mo) comfortably covers this allocation.

action.inr: Set aside {{monthlyNeeded}} monthly in a dedicated Bank Recurring Deposit (RD) to ensure funds are ready when due. Check current terms on the official site.
action.default: Set aside {{monthlyNeeded}} monthly in a dedicated liquid savings account to guarantee funds are ready when due.

shortfall.title: Future Expense Shortfall: {{goalName}}
shortfall.detail: Upcoming target '{{goalName}}' requires {{monthlyNeeded}}/mo across {{months}} remaining months, but your current monthly surplus is only {{surplus}}/mo. You face an estimated monthly shortfall of {{shortfall}}.
shortfall.action: Review and reduce discretionary expenses or extend the target timeline to bridge the {{shortfall}}/mo gap.

ontrack.title: Savings Goal: {{goalName}}
ontrack.detail: With a monthly net savings rate of {{surplus}}/mo, goal '{{goalName}}' is estimated for completion by {{completionDate}}.
ontrack.action: Maintain monthly contributions of {{surplus}} to stay on track for estimated completion by {{completionDate}}.

deficit.title: Savings Goal: {{goalName}}
deficit.detail: Current monthly spending exceeds income ({{deficit}}/mo deficit), halting progress on active goal '{{goalName}}'.
deficit.action: Reduce monthly discretionary expenses to resolve the {{deficit}} deficit and resume contributions toward '{{goalName}}'.

longterm.title: Long-Term Wealth Vehicle: {{goalName}}
longterm.detail: Goal '{{goalName}}' has an extended horizon of over 3 years (~{{months}} months). Long horizons can benefit from disciplined compounded savings vehicles.

action.inr: Consider government-backed long-term compounding instruments such as Public Provident Fund (PPF) or National Pension System (NPS). Check current terms on the official site.
action.default: Consider long-term diversified retirement and compounding investment accounts over extended horizons.

surplus.title: Surplus Allocation: Long-Term Savings
surplus.detail: With your emergency reserve intact and an estimated monthly surplus of {{surplus}}, you have capacity for long-term disciplined wealth accumulation.

action.inr: Direct surplus cash flow into structured long-term schemes like PPF or NPS for compounding and tax efficiency. Check current terms on the official site.
action.default: Direct surplus cash flow into disciplined long-term retirement accounts or diversified broad-market index funds.

edu.title: Investment Options to Learn About
edu.detail: Asset classes grouped by risk profile: Low Risk (Bank Fixed/Recurring Deposits, Government Savings Bonds), Medium Risk (Balanced Hybrid Funds, Large-Cap Index Funds), High Risk (Broad Equity Index Funds, Sectoral Equities). General information, not investment advice.
edu.action: Build and preserve your emergency buffer before allocating capital to market-linked instruments. Never invest based on short-term price targets.
